We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA. We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans. We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment. Job Description About the job Support the Business Navigation & Operations Manager in navigating the growth and securing sustained profitability of IKANO. Drive the business navigation processes, including staff cost and productivity development. Be a pro-active, trustworthy business partner to the Country Business Navigation Manager, Finance Managers and store steering team by steering and challenging the actual business performance for the assigned area of responsibility. Your assignment Provide store steering team with information, analysis, and expert insight to support, challenge, and steer the store towards growth, optimal performance, and sustained longterm profitability. Promote standardised dashboards and secure competence in the store to allow for analysis and understanding of performance and for making optimal decisions. Contribute to new ways of measuring and steering the business performance in an omnichannel environment, including productivity goals and productivity measurements to ensure performance. Have a full overview of store profit & loss and take responsibility for cost development and gross margin management, as well as for specific lines of the profit & loss, supporting Store and Country Business Navigation Manager in achieving a healthy profit & loss through key performance analysis and evaluation. Responsible for overall forecasting and monitoring, including the execution of working hours and staff cost structure, as well as budget, to ensure that set targets are met. Contribute with business navigation expertise in driving projects and business initiatives forward to secure the budget frame and healthy cost development. Develop and drive short-, mid-, and long-term resource planning, together with the HR manager to ensure cost efficiency. Conduct the necessary analysis, while securing a multi-dimensional view of the business, to evaluate retail performance with the customer in focus. Contribute with input and coordinate the financial business planning, budgeting, and followup for the assigned areas of responsibility to ensure goals are met. Responsible for commercial sales navigation on the sales floor to secure sustained profitability. Contribute with input and provide expertise to the store boards to enable performance. Qualifications Possess at least minimum 1-3 years of experience in a retail market, preferably from store or country company level, with a good understanding of how the commercial and financial processes work. Possess at least minimum 1-3 years of experience of developing new ways of working and implementing proven solutions for efficiency purposes. Possess at least minimum 1-3 years of experience in data analysis, developing metrics and projections based on analysis results. Proven track record in delivering under time pressure. Able to work on computer/smart device literate, tech-savvy Able to speak fluently in English, both written and spoken Additional Information Additional information You are invited to this Life at Home journey with IKEA. Click here to begin Life at Home Journey with IKEA. Your job application will be prioritized when you complete the life at Home Journey with IKEA. Please apply by 30 September 2026. Working with us has its rewards Wherever you work within IKEA Southeast Asia, you enjoy a wide range of benefits. Here are just some of them: IKEA discounts Co-workers are our most values customers and are entitled to a 15% discount on any home furnishings and food sold in our stores, from the first day of work. Flexi Benefits We offer flexi benefits to cater our co-workers who are in different life stages with differing benefits needs. Within an annual Flexible Spending Account, co-workers can claim against dental, optical, fitness memberships or classes, vaccination or immunisation, non-insured outpatient medical expenses, health screenings, health supplements, IKEA purchases, health aid & equipment and mental health. Maternity and paternity leave We give mother four consecutive months of maternity leave and father receives four weeks of paid time off after a baby has arrived to help share the joys – and responsible – at home. Gifts We enjoy special occasions together and give tokens to mark birthdays, marriage, the arrival of a baby. We reward loyalty through our Long Service Awards. Work environment As home furnish experts, we take pride in providing inspiring workplaces that showcase IKEA products and crate a relaxed, open atmosphere where we work side by side. Incentive plan All co-workers may earn an annual financial reward when we meet our shared business objectives.

review_candidates.description: Saga is a legal innovation company on a mission to remove the friction between legal expertise and real-world impact, so lawyers can focus on what matters the most: people, ethics, and impact. In just 18 months, we've grown to 85+ employees and 6,000+ users across 20+ countries - with market leadership in Norway and the Netherlands, and active expansion across Europe. We believe technology shouldn't replace legal reasoning, but strengthen it - so the law can work as it's meant to: aligned, accountable, and capable of delivering justice for everyone. Your role as Account Manager Imagine being the first person who shows a law firm what AI can really do for their practice. In this role, you're introducing an entire profession to technology that will reshape how they work. Every call, demo, and event where you represent Saga, you're helping lawyers see a different future for themselves. As the Account Manager you drive outbound growth in Belgium. You prospect, identify, and qualify new law firms through research, calls, emails, LinkedIn, and events. You open the door for new clients, run discovery calls that uncover real needs, and deliver product demos that spark interest. Belgium is ours to build. You'll own the market end to end - pipeline, relationships, and the approach that works here - shoulder to shoulder with the commercial team. If you like early-stage work where the playbook isn't written yet, this is that. What you’ll be doing Own how we go to market in Belgium - working out which firms to focus on, how we reach them, and what we open with, then adjusting as you learn what lands Build and run the full pipeline yourself, from first outreach through discovery, demos, objection handling and negotiation, with the wider Saga team behind you Turn what you hear in the market into a Belgian playbook, and share it back with sales, marketing and product teams so it strengthens how we work everywhere Build relationships that last - with law firms, legal networks and local partners - and represent Saga at events and workshops across the country Keep your pipeline honest and current in HubSpot, so the picture of the market is clear to you and to everyone else What you bring to our team You're a sales professional who thrives in fast-paced environments. You know how to prospect, qualify, and move deals forward. You handle rejection like a pro and get energized by turning interest into action. You also bring: Relevant experience in B2B sales, Account Management, or business development, in SaaS, technology, or professional services. We're a team of lawyers, engineers, and builders spread across multiple countries and continents, bringing a genuinely international perspective to everything we do. If you thrive in a flat, high-ownership environment where you're building from the ground up, this is the place for you. Verzorgen van de efficiënte inrichting van IT-infrastructuren op de werkplek. Inzichtelijk houden van het beheer en de distributie van hardware. Af en toe bijspringen bij je collega IT helpdesk en faciliteren dat hij steeds zelfstandiger aan de slag kan gaan. Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk? Je krijgt de kans om zelfstandig op pad te gaan en IT-problemen op jouw manier op te lossen. Je komt op verschillende locaties met uiteenlopende bedrijfsculturen en ontvangt elke dag weer vanuit een andere hoek waardering. Buiten jouw brede takenpakket krijg je ook nog de kans om met jouw collega te sparren en hem aan te sturen. Je lost problemen niet alleen op, maar kunt ook uitleggen hoe ze te voorkomen, zelfs aan collega’s die minder bekend zijn in de IT-wereld. Je hebt een sociale en dienstverlenende houding en bent niet bang om proactief op collega’s af te stappen. Je bent communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels.
